```{r setup}
#| include: false
set.seed(42)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here::here("R/features.R"))
```

## Data Loading

```{r load-data}
df_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("data/raw/customers.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
dplyr::glimpse(df_raw)
```

## Feature Engineering

```{r compute-features}
df <- compute_features(df_raw)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r summary-stats}
df |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    churn_rate = mean(churned),
    median_tenure_months = median(tenure_months),
    median_spend = median(monthly_spend),
    pct_high_value = mean(high_value)
  )
```

## Churn Rate by Tenure

```{r plot-tenure-churn}
df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    churned_label = factor(churned, labels = c("Retained", "Churned"))
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = tenure_months, fill = churned_label)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Tenure Distribution by Churn Status",
    x = "Tenure (months)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Status",
    caption = "Source: customer_churn dataset"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

## Spend vs Churn

```{r plot-spend-churn}
df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    churned_label = factor(churned, labels = c("Retained", "Churned"))
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(x = churned_label, y = monthly_spend, fill = churned_label)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Monthly Spend by Churn Status",
    x = "Status",
    y = "Monthly Spend (USD)",
    caption = "Source: customer_churn dataset"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

## Support Tickets vs Churn

```{r plot-tickets-churn}
df |>
  dplyr::group_by(support_tickets, churned) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    churned_label = factor(churned, labels = c("Retained", "Churned"))
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(x = support_tickets, y = n, fill = churned_label)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = "fill", alpha = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Churn Rate by Support Ticket Volume",
    x = "Number of Support Tickets",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Status",
    caption = "Source: customer_churn dataset"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
